q-182384.name: Question 3
q-182384.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,(A∧B)∨A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
q-182384.worked_solution:
First, we complete a truth table for the part in parentheses, $A∧B.$  The statement $A∧B$ is true if both $A$ and $B$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we look at the columns labeled $A∧B$ and $A$ to complete the column $(A∧B)∨A.$ The statement $(A∧B)∨A$ is true if either $A∧B$ is true, $A$ is true, or both $A∧B$ and $A$ are true. 

The completed truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ | $\,(A∧B)∨A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

q-182400.name: Question 5
q-182400.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧(A∧B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
q-182400.worked_solution:
First, we complete a truth table for the part in parentheses, $A∧B.$ The statement $A∧B$ is true if both $A$ and $B$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we look at the columns labeled $B$ and $A∧B$ to complete the column $B∧(A∧B).$ The statement $B∧(A∧B)$ is true if both $B$ and $A∧B$ are true. 

The completed truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ | $\,B∧(A∧B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
